idea-plugin.name: Opt Chain
idea-plugin.description:
Supports JavaScript-style optional chaining ?. in Java sources for the java-opt-chain Maven toolchain (preprocess + ASM weave).

  • Suppresses illegal-token / red-line errors on ?. (HighlightErrorFilter + HighlightInfoFilter)
  • Highlights ?. operators
  • Field and method completion after receiver?. (same ?. → . rewrite)
  • Go to Declaration on fields and methods accessed via ?.

Compilation still requires the Maven opt-chain plugin; this IDE plugin only improves the editor experience.

Compatible with IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1+ through 2025.2 (build 241–252+).
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.0 — Plugin id and implementation package are now io.github.chensirj.optchain.idea. Uninstall the old plugin (id io.ch.java.opt.chain.idea) before installing this build. Editor behavior is unchanged from 0.1.2.

0.1.2 — Field chains share completion and navigation with methods. Go to Declaration falls back to a field of the qualifier type when resolve() is empty. Highlight filters unchanged.

0.1.1 — Stronger red-squiggle suppression (HighlightInfoFilter + wider ?. matching); explicit 2025.2 / build 252 support.

0.1.0 — Initial release: error filter, highlight, completion, navigation.
